:::{#def-squared-error-risk}
#### Squared-error risk

The **squared-error risk** of a prediction function $\predfnf{\Predvar}$
is the [risk](#def-risk) under squared error loss,
the expected square of its [prediction error](#def-prediction-error),
which compares $\predfnf{\Predvar}$ with the observed [outcome](#def-outcome) $\Outvar$ of a [new data point](#def-new-data-point),
the [estimand](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/estimation.html#def-estimand) of the prediction:

$$\popriskf{\predfn} \eqdef \E{\sqf{\prederr_{\predfn}}}$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exm-squared-error-risk}
#### Squared-error risk in the best-predictor exercise

In @exr-best-predictor,
the constant [prediction](#def-prediction) $\predfn_1\paren{\Predvar} = 3$ has [squared-error risk](#def-squared-error-risk) $\popriskf{\predfn_1} = 5$.

:::
